description: A CLI entrypoint-structure check flags scenarios whose `cli/main.go` owns command or infrastructure setup instead of staying a thin process boundary.

requirements.description: The `cli-health validate <scenario>` command must inspect each scenario's `cli/main.go` entrypoint and verify it delegates to `NewApp`/`app.Run`, `cmd.Execute`, or an equivalent CLI runner. Scenarios whose `main()` performs direct infrastructure setup or accumulates non-delegating command/business logic must produce a warning-level `cli.main_heavy` finding. These findings must not fail validation by themselves, but they must appear in the maturity assessment and validation output.
requirements.title: Non-Canonical CLI Pattern Detection Across Scenarios

validation.notes: A direct server setup in cli/main.go returns cli.main_heavy at warning severity.
The current scenario-app pattern (NewApp plus app.Run) returns no entrypoint finding.
A lifecycle guard plus app delegation returns no entrypoint finding.
A non-delegating busy main() returns cli.main_heavy without relying on raw line-count heuristics.
The validator reads cli/main.go next to the manifest path used by ValidateScenario.
Enforcing the canonical CLI pattern ensures consistent behaviour, flag parsing, and error formatting across all scenario CLIs

title: Non-canonical CLI pattern detection
